# [TFQ-2510] The 0-cocycle test does not separate contextual models

## Statement

Every no-signalling model, the PR box included, has delta0 e = 0 (node OPS-CECH-COBOUNDARY). So the test delta0 e = 0 does not separate contextual from noncontextual no-signalling models. This is a statement about the test, not about the class of e: in the unaugmented complex H^0 = ker delta0, so distinct no-signalling models are distinct classes. What the class lacks is an invariant that separates conv(A) from its complement; that separation is a positivity constraint. The earlier sentence that the class "carries no information about probabilistic contextuality" is narrowed to this.

## Governing obligation

Not a statement about every possible cohomological invariant. Not formalised in Lean.
